title: Can We Jump from Cross-Sectional to Dynamic Interpretations of Networks? Implications for the Network Perspective in Psychiatry
limitations: - Limited generalizability due to small sample size; - Cross-sectional networks may not reflect causal dynamics; - No formal test of centrality differences between groups beyond visual inspection.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. No preregistration is mentioned. The authors used STATA for estimation and R for visualization, but no specific estimation packages are cited.
